articles.headline: Will Lankshear scores brace as Middlesbrough come back to survive scare and beat Lincoln
articles.description: Marquee signing Will Lankshear notched a second-half double as Middlesbrough fought back to kick off their Championship bid with a hard-fought 2-1 victory and inflict a first defeat in eight and a half months on newly promoted Lincoln.

images.caption: Will Lankshear scored his first Championship goal for Middlesbrough to level the scores.

articles.headline: Raúl Jiménez marks Wolves return by rescuing draw with Blackburn

keyEvents.text: Own Goal by Kayne Ramsay, Charlton Athletic. Millwall 1, Charlton Athletic 0.
Karoy Anderson (Charlton Athletic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Millwall 1, Charlton Athletic 0.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Ibrahim Fullah replaces Luke Chambers.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Reece Burke replaces Macaulay Gillesphey.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Charlie Kelman replaces Karoy Anderson.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Conor Coventry replaces Sonny Carey.
Substitution, Millwall. Mihailo Ivanovic replaces Josh Coburn.
Tristan Crama (Millwall) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Millwall. Aidomo Emakhu replaces Casper De Norre.
Goal! Millwall 2, Charlton Athletic 0. Caleb Taylor (Millwall) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Alfie Doughty with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Millwall. Zak Sturge replaces Alfie Doughty.
Substitution, Millwall. Luke Cundle replaces Macaulay Langstaff.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Matty Godden replaces Joe Rankin-Costello.
Penalty saved. Camiel Neghli (Millwall) left footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Thomas Kaminski (Charlton Athletic).
Goal! Millwall 3, Charlton Athletic 0. Luke Cundle (Millwall) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Camiel Neghli following a set piece situation.
Goal! Millwall 4, Charlton Athletic 0. Aidomo Emakhu (Millwall) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner following a fast break.
